label: Revenue by Customer Tier
description: Order count and revenue grouped by the customer's loyalty tier. Joins the order table to the customer table on a verified relationship.
formula_plain_english: count(*) and sum(revenue_amount) grouped by customer_tier
sql: SELECT {{customer_tier}} AS tier, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM({{revenue_amount}}) AS revenue FROM {{fact}} GROUP BY {{customer_tier}} ORDER BY revenue DESC
